text.en:
The President of the Philippines is authorized to enter into a compromise with the oppositors to
the probate of the will of the late Con Francisco R. Santos, upon such terms and conditions as he may
determine to be convenient in the public interest, to execute the necessary documents, and to carry into effect
the compromise so agreed upon.

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved, May 26, 1940.
